rows.name: [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Melia. What will you do now?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I would like to repay you for your help.[XENO:n ]
Permit me to act as your guide to Eryth Sea.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Of course! We'd love you to.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]But I must warn you. Eryth Sea is vast.[XENO:n ]
Do you know where you wish to go?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
There's a dark tower at the head of the Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I saw it in a vision.[XENO:n ]
That's where I must go.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]A dark tower? Then we[XENO:n ]
need not search at all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So you've heard of it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Heard of it? I have seen it.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]A dark tower at the head of the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
Only one place fits that description.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So you know it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I believe what you saw was Prison Island.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Prison Island. Dikson-san said the same thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Indeed. Melia, have you ever been there?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I have not set foot upon the island, but I know of it.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Prison Island is sealed. No one may[XENO:n ]
enter without imperial sanction.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Imperial sanction? That means we'll be[XENO:n ]
needing someone to grant us entry.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I've heard that Eryth Sea is home to an empire ruled[XENO:n ]
by the High Entia. They might be our best chance.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You are knowledgable for a Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Sanctions, empires?[XENO:n ]
Anyone help here?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]A sanction is permission from someone important.[XENO:n ]
An empire must be a place ruled by an Emperor. In other[XENO:n ]
words, we need an Emperor's permission to enter the island.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]This Emperor... Is he important?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Long before we Homs built the colonies...[XENO:wait wait=key ]

A group of so-called royal-types or[XENO:n ]
imperials ruled our lands.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Think of them like the heads of our colony.[XENO:n ]
But with much greater influence and power.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Now I get it. Dunban knows[XENO:n ]
more than a textbook![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Are you kidding? That's first year[XENO:n ]
Homs history, Rein![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ]I might have slept through that class...[XENO:wait wait=key ]

So when do we get to meet[XENO:n ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]these High Entia folks?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]You are so... Forget it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]First we must travel to the imperial capital.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We'll see how easy it is[XENO:n ]
to see this Emperor.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]My promise was to be your guide.[XENO:n ]
I will not break it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Melia, isn't that the...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
The shortcut to Eryth Sea, yes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
